Motion API with Collision Detection

Demonstrates the unified Motion API with collision-aware path planning NEW runWithCollision()

Loading WASM module...

New Features in Motion API

1. WasmMotion.runWithCollision()

Single motion with BiRRT collision-free planning

const result = WasmMotion.to(goal) .safe() // Enable collision mode .smooth() .runWithCollision(robot, checkCollision);

2. WasmPath.runWithCollision()

Multi-waypoint path with collision-free segments

const result = WasmPath.through(waypoints, 6) .safe() .runWithCollision(robot, checkCollision);

3. WasmSequence.runWithCollision()

Sequence of motions with collision planning

const result = WasmSequence .start(motion1.safe()) .then(motion2.safe()) .runWithCollision(robot, checkCollision);

Collision Configuration

Simple joint-space obstacle for demonstration

Obstacle Zone (Joint 1 & 2)

Collision Checker Code

function checkCollision(joints) { const j1 = joints[0], j2 = joints[1]; // Returns true if collision-free if (j1 >= obsJ1Min && j1 <= obsJ1Max && j2 >= obsJ2Min && j2 <= obsJ2Max) { return false; // In collision } return true; // Collision-free }
